_notes: This wraps the live PWA in a native iOS shell for the Apple App Store (Apple does not accept TWAs).

Two modes: (A) server.url points at the hosted site (fastest to a working build, shown here); (B) remove server.url and bundle the built web assets into webDir so the app ships self-contained — stronger for App Store Guideline 4.2 (minimum functionality). Prefer (B) before submitting, and add real native capability via Capacitor plugins (Camera, Push Notifications, Haptics).

Setup on a Mac: `npm i @capacitor/core @capacitor/cli @capacitor/ios`, place this file at repo root as capacitor.config.json, then `npx cap add ios` and `npx cap open ios`. Add NSCameraUsageDescription to ios/App/App/Info.plist for the scanner.
appId must match the Bundle ID you register in your Apple Developer account.
